title: FAIRSISA: ENSEMBLE POST-PROCESSING TO IMPROVE FAIRNESS OF UNLEARNING IN LLMS
findings: The SISA unlearning framework can degrade fairness in LLMs for toxic text classification when religion is treated as a sensitive attribute, leading to higher bias (poorer Equalized Odds scores) compared to a conventionally trained single model. The proposed post-processing methods, particularly 'Ensemble Post-Process' and 'Post-process then Aggregate', successfully mitigate this bias and improve the accuracy-fairness trade-off.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured group fairness (using the equalized odds metric) in toxic text classification. Specifically, it evaluated whether the model's performance was unfairly influenced by the presence or absence of terms related to religion in the text.
